features.name: the directory
features.desc-on-touch: The same listing as ever, and beneath it a folder nobody made. There are documents that, of course, he did not add. Ninety something kilobytes of plain text, no author field: the better part of an hour on this connection.

features.name: record 00_051
features.desc-on-touch: The archive is asking for something. Nothing surprises him.

art: Request: Photograph of hall before ramp

features.name: the weatherproof mesh distributor
features.desc-on-touch: He connects, expecting nothing. A line like the horizon beneath a sun in backwards bloom. Incredible. It still loads after all these years.

features.name: a photograph, sent
features.desc-on-touch: A hall, weatherboard, four steps and a boot scraper, her elbow at the edge of the frame. It says Bunyah on the side. He does not know if it is the hall anyone meant.

file.name: Their_Most_August_Public_Organ.txt
file.note: Plain text, no author field. Sentences already heard a thousand times, in a voice that is not his. You are in it.

exits.label: the enormity of nationhood
exits.to: NEW: the next abandoned motel rooftop along the Darling, where the signal still pulses and the building has fewer years left than the batteries
